text.description_html:
Fusion 16-Z8, Elite Collection Victorian Clear Glass Knob with Rope Rose

Let's be honest here, glass knobs give off a feminine air. Your husband might be looking at you like your crazy for wanting to install this Clear Glass Knob with Rope Rose, but this knobset definitely has a place in the right setting. It is beautiful, and in its cut glass, the glamour of the old world is reflected. Antique-looking knobs are rapidly growing more popular in home decor and it isn't because they are plain. The ornateness of this Victorian Glass Knobset will add it charm to any room of your home. It will fit 1-1/4 inch to 2 inch thick doors and has an adjustable backset for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. Choose from 5 finishes for the Rope Rosette.

Features of the Fusion 16 Z8 Clear Glass Knob with Rope Rose:

  • Solid Brass/Bronze Construction
  • Cycle Tested to ANSI Standards
  • Exclusive Fusion knob spring assembly for lifetime performance.
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish.
  • Easy assembly with alignment block and rose posts.
  • Concealed screw rose cover.

Specifications for the Victorian Glass Knob With Rope Rosette:

  • Knob Diameter: 2-3/8"
  • Knob Projection: 2-3/8"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" to 2-3/4"
  • Knob Material: Glass
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Square corner latches and strike plates.
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials, and operation.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: Non-functional pull to match trim on one side of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Dummy Set: Non-functional pull to match trim on both sides of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
